TV resolution and effect names on the TV.

- New TV resolution option (Settings > TV, or the menu): 480p (the NUON's own, the default), 720p, 1080p or the TV's own. Lower is smoother over a cast; higher looks sharper on a cable. You can change it while casting.
- With TV only, the on-screen messages now show on the TV instead of the dark handheld: the effect number when it changes, the track name, and the music status.
- While casting, Music (VLM) briefly shows every effect change on the TV, including the automatic ones.
